hook: A fresh search in 2026 targets the exact Pacific atoll where Amelia Earhart vanished in 1937.

sections.voiceover: A fresh search in 2026 targets the exact Pacific atoll where Amelia Earhart vanished in 1937.
b_roll: Map showing the Pacific Ocean and Kiribati

sections.voiceover: Researchers from the Archaeological Legacy Institute boarded the Marin Mainiku vessel in Kiribati. Teams crossed the South Pacific toward Nikumaroro Island. What lies buried beneath the waters of Nikumaroro?
b_roll: The Marin Mainiku vessel at sea

sections.voiceover: This October expedition investigates the Taraia Object, but Fred Noonan's fate remains unknown.
b_roll: Researchers reviewing charts on the ship

sections.voiceover: Teams documented physical debris matching the Lockheed Electra. Investigators hope to finally solve the 1937 disappearance.
b_roll: Underwater dive team near a reef
Metal wreckage artifact on the seabed

sections.voiceover: History awaits the 2026 data from Nikumaroro.
